fields.value: MPR0=$FF, MPR1=$F8, MPR2=128, MPR3=129, MPR4=130, MPR5=131, MPR6=1/132 (toggles), MPR7=0; reset vector PC=$E0F3; wait loop CC06-CC11; SCSI phase 0 (no CD command) on synthetic/real media
fields.note: Measured on Super CD-ROM System 3.0 (./rom/syscard3.pce, not committed) via local black-box reset-stepping probe (2026-10-30, Geargrafx pinned revision b49ae82a...). Reset vector PC=$E0F3 (INIT before first instruction). MPRs become [FF,F8,80,81,82,83,84/85,00] within ~20 instructions (MPR6 toggles 1<->132). After ~1500 instructions the BIOS enters a stable wait loop (PC CC06-CC11) with SCSI phase 0 for >=100k steps on synthetic and real game media; no CD command issued and no auto-boot observed (consistent with BIOS startup screen waiting for controller input). INIT registers are core reset values and vary per run. MPR2-5 are System Card ROM bank numbers and must not be copied verbatim into DEV BIOS. Non-returning conclusion is an observation of the reset path, not proof of slot $00 ABI. REFERENCE_OBSERVATION evidence class; recorded as HYPOTHESIS pending schema extension.
